chicken.description: Feathered alarm system with legs. Lays eggs, questions reality, and reminds farmers that panic is also a survival strategy.

chick.description: Tiny feathered bundle of potential. Chirps with optimism, pecks at the world, and serves as a reminder that even the smallest employees can have big dreams.

cow.description: Gentle milk philosopher with four stomachs and one eternal thought: chew first, understand later.

pig.description: Domestic swine - best known for involvement in the invention of bacon

majesticHog.description: Legendary pig with a crown of flowers. Known for its regal presence and the ability to turn mud into a throne.

piglet.description: Tiny swine with big dreams. Known for its playful nature and ability to find joy in mud puddles.

sheep.description: Woolly cloud with legs. Follows the herd until the herd gets lost, then calls it collective wisdom.

lamb.description: Young woolly cloud with legs. Innocent, curious, and a reminder that even the smallest members of the herd have a voice.

goat.description: Mountain goblin disguised as livestock. Eats cans, climbs problems, and teaches that chaos is just ambition without a chair.

duck.description: Waterproof philosopher of the pond. Calm above the water, furious little engine of nonsense underneath.

turkey.description: Dramatic feather committee with seasonal anxiety. Gobbles like it knows a prophecy and refuses to explain it.

rabbit.description: Soft little multiplication wizard. Appears harmless, then suddenly the farm has seventeen more problems with ears.

fish.description: Silent aquatic minimalist. Says nothing, knows everything, and judges land animals for needing so much gravity.

shrimp.description: Tiny sea comma with big existential energy. Small enough to ignore, wise enough to survive the soup of history.

oyster.description: Closed-shell introvert hiding treasure and opinions. Teaches that pressure creates pearls, but also social avoidance.

squid.description: Ink-powered escape artist with too many arms and not enough accountability. When clarity fails, deploy darkness.

dinosaur.description: Ancient farm guardian with tiny arms and enormous opinions. Excellent for security, terrible for delicate crops and emotional nuance.

diplodocus.description: Long-necked gentle giant who sees problems before anyone else. Slow to anger, quick to snack on treetops and unrealistic plans.

ent.description: Sentient tree-like creature from fantasy lore. Guardians of the forest and nature. A wise and powerful ally for sustainable farming and environmental stewardship.

rat.description: Small rodent known for adaptability and resourcefulness. Can be a pest or a pet, depending on the context. Sometimes can deliver You a surprise - a Plague!

goose.description: Waterfowl known for its honking and aggressive behavior. Honk honk! Honk lauder! A noisy but loyal companion for farm life, always ready to defend its territory.

snail.description: Ultra-slow productivity consultant. Will reach the barn eventually, probably after the next software release.

bee.description: Small flying employee with excellent teamwork skills. Produces honey, pollinates crops, and has a strict no-nonsense attitude.

hedgehog.description: Small defensive potato with legs. Excellent at looking cute while being emotionally unavailable.

owl.description: Night-shift supervisor with silent wings and strong code review energy. The owls are not what they seem, especially near the Red Room.

lobster.description: Armored sea aristocrat with built-in scissors. Useful for underwater farm politics and aggressively opening packages.

yak.description: Mountain-grade cow alternative with premium fluff. Perfect for cold farms, dramatic weather, and looking like it knows ancient secrets.

boar.description: Wild pig with unstoppable delivery energy. Proves that moving fast can solve problems, create problems, and destroy the fence between them.

ant.description: Tiny logistics engineer with terrifying team alignment. Proves that big systems are built by small creatures who never skip standup.

tardigrade.description: Microscopic survival legend. Laughs at drought, frost, chaos, and release deadlines, then asks whether that was supposed to be difficult.

tortoise.description: Ancient walking helmet with premium patience. Wins by arriving late enough for everyone else to make the mistakes first.
